column3: Close to the Hebrew; “tent pegs” is rendered “stakes.”
Close to the Hebrew; “spread out” is rendered “expand.”
Close to the Hebrew; the plurals “husbands… makers” (of majesty) are rendered singular.
Close to the Hebrew; “a wife of youth if she is rejected” is rendered “Like a youthful wife when you were refused.”
Close to the Hebrew; “compassion” is rendered “mercies.”
Close to the Hebrew; בְּשֶׁצֶף (“overflowing”) is rendered “With a little,” and וּבְחֶסֶד (hesed) “with everlasting kindness.”
NKJV reads “like the waters of Noah,” following manuscripts with “waters” (ke-me).
Close to the Hebrew; וְחַסְדִּי (hesed) is rendered “My kindness.”
Close to the Hebrew; “in antimony” is rendered “with colorful gems.”
Close to the Hebrew; “battlements” is rendered “pinnacles,” “beryl” “crystal,” and “border” “walls.”
NKJV renders יָגוּר (“stir up strife” or “gather”) as “assemble,” and “on you he will fall” “shall fall for your sake.”
